name: verse-windows
description: Independent Windows animated lyrics desktop app inspired by Verci

scripts.bridge: dotnet publish bridge/MediaBridge.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o bridge/bin/publish
scripts.build: npm run check && npm test && npm run bridge && electron-builder --win dir
scripts.package: npm run check && npm test && npm run bridge && electron-builder --win portable
